question: Should OpenClaw adopt this new operator-selected readiness configuration and plugin readiness callback as a supported core and plugin-SDK contract after the foundation PR is decided?
rationale: The branch introduces durable configuration and plugin API surfaces, and choosing their supported scope cannot be resolved mechanically from tests or the contributor’s implementation alone.

options.title: Sponsor staged readiness adoption
options.body: Decide the foundation contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104018 first, then request an owner-only restack and exact-head runtime proof for this follow-on layer.

options.title: Pause the core API direction
options.body: Keep the PR open but defer it until maintainers define whether plugin-supplied readiness checks belong in the permanent SDK contract.

options.title: Decline the core expansion
options.body: Close the stacked proposal if maintainers do not want operator-selectable readiness and plugin callback surfaces in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor staged readiness adoption
recommendation.body: Decide the foundation contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104018 first, then request an owner-only restack and exact-head runtime proof for this follow-on layer.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the coupled readiness proposals and can restack or narrow the implementation after a maintainer decision.
